race.comment: RISKY WHISKY (1) bounced off his good third two-back with a well-deserved victory over 1000m at Bairnsdale. This looks a sterner test but comes here in peak condition. Respect. BARGINO (4) returns from a let-up and best form is on his home track. Sat off the fast tempo and picked them up with ease to clear out for a slick win over 1000m at this track on May 26. Yet to see a heavy track and don't dismiss. CALAIS BLISS (5) resumes after a spell of eight months. Opened last prep with a second at this track over 900m. Very good fresh performer. Hasn't trialled in the lead-up to this so may pay to watch the betting. INDUCTION (2) followed a win at Wangaratta two starts ago with a third last start over 1000m at Seymour, beaten 2.5 lengths. Going well and in the mix.
